occurrences.quote_span: For decades the island of New Avalon was home to Ruth Hume Semple — the only daughter of a wealthy industrialist — and her guests, a rotating cast of women with, as the story goes, paranormal abilities.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Riley Sager's The Unknown

occurrences.quote_span: Among the five women cast are the legendary actress Violet Wright, to play Mrs. Semple, and a newcomer, Marin Keane, to star as Daisy.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Riley Sager's The Unknown

occurrences.quote_span: Horrifyingly, all that was left behind were five dresses swinging from the branches of a massive oak tree and the detailed diary of Daisy Rue, one of Mrs. Semple’s gifted guests.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Riley Sager's The Unknown

occurrences.quote_span: The cast will spend a week on New Avalon, living as closely as possible to the way the women they will be portraying would have lived.
occurrences.speaker: Ronan Peters

occurrences.quote_span: When she finally does confront her trauma, it feels less like a revelation and more like a segue.

occurrences.quote_span: Marin, who functions as something between a final girl and a self-proclaimed “gullible witness,” exists more as a plot device than a memorable heroine.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Riley Sager's The Unknown

occurrences.quote_span: Within hours, the cast is confronted with chaos, both earthly and otherworldly: jealousy between the ambitious actors and inexplicable phenomena that are all but directly pulled from the pages of their script.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own

occurrences.quote_span: She’s driven by a family tragedy and a desire “to be known” as an actress, but everything sort of just happens to her.
